method: ImageMagick scale/alpha ramp on a fixed 256x256 canvas — 50%/80%/100%/108%/116%/124% at alpha 1.00/1.00/1.00/0.74/0.42/0.16. Frames are derived rather than drawn individually so registration cannot drift and every frame is the same blast.
audited: per-frame mean alpha measured to confirm the rise-then-decay ramp (0.040 / 0.103 / 0.161 / 0.139 / 0.091 / 0.040); an earlier pass shipped frames 1-3 at ~1% alpha from a shell quoting bug and was rebuilt
